newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Donghwa Leasing to extend Jinro notes.
newsitem.headline: Donghwa Leasing to extend Jinro notes.

text.p: Donghwa Leasing Co Ltd, which now holds about eight billion won worth of the troubled Jinro Ltd's promissory notes, said on Tuesday it would extend repayment of the notes to next February.
Jinro failed to repay the loans on Monday and it faced a second deadline on Tuesday to avoid final default, which would have triggered court-receivership proceedings.
"We have decided to extend repayment of Jinro's loans because of worries about the adverse impacts the default would have on the nation's economy," said a Donghwa official.
Unlisted Donghwa Leasing Co Ltd earlier said it had its own financial problems.
Jinro's creditor banks urged Jinro to give up its managerial rights in exchange for emergency loans. But Jinro turned down the offer and said it would seek a reprieve from Donghwa.
In April, Jinro Group became the first conglomerate to benefit from a bank committee's programme to keep troubled corporates afloat. The committee protected Jinro for two months.
